feature_input: C only, no Q, B, external BG, candidate scores, truth, or target ID
feature_design: Fixed aggregate structural, quantization, entropy, distribution-shape, and dependence diagnostics; train-only standardization
primary_baseline: Single method-background chosen by mean training-target TPR, separately inside every outer fold
ensembles: uniform rank mean of every candidate
median/max of eight fixed family rank means
mean/median/max of eight training-selected family champions
training-performance-weighted family champions with fixed temperature .05
rank_ties: average ranks for blending, original min-rank confidence for official evaluation
holdout: Entire target held out; no person-fold mixing. Features scaled and all choices made using training targets only. Fixed all20 base-score inference remains public transductive.
report_views: 18-target outer LOTO excluding1_2 from both training and evaluation
oracle: Per-target best candidate is an infeasible descriptive upper bound, never a deployable method
limits: The full candidate grids have historical preliminary-label exposure. New LOTO excludes evaluation labels from the new selector/ensemble, but does not create an untouched external validation set. Does not identify true anonymization algorithm uniquely.
resource_limits: One thread; stream one family-background bank; no base-model reruns; no external publication
publication: Aggregate tables, source code and hashes only. Per-person scores stay private.
